summary: Implemented custom global generators loaded by name from the cache extensions/generators folder. Changes: (1) conans/client/cache/cache.py adds GENERATORS_EXTENSION_FOLDER = "generators" and a generators_path property. (2) conans/client/generators/__init__.py: _get_generator_class(name, generators_path=None) falls back to <generators_path>/<name>.py, returning the class named <name>; error messages list custom generators; write_generators(conanfile, hook_manager, generators_path=None) passes the path through. (3) conans/client/installer.py (_build and editable path) and conan/api/subapi/install.py pass the cache generators_path. Choices: built-in names take precedence; file name must match class name. Not run (per instructions); verified by reading only. No tests added, no docs written (docs are in another repo), nothing committed.
